notes.v1_05: Saddle: Draw the hay bale as a few broad, soft clumps in a slightly paler, duller straw colour. Make the leather smooth with a soft sheen, with one subtle seam in place of the stitch lines on every edge and no rivets. Keep the stirrup, the horn, the rope ties and the cyan backdrop.
notes.v1_07: Barrel: Make the dirt floor a smooth, plain soft brown with no pebbles or specks, and make the cast shadow softer and shorter. Make the wood grain on the staves faint and fine in place of the big swirls. Keep the emblem, the iron hoops and the blue stripes.
notes.v1_08: Covered Wagon: Make the dirt ground smooth and plain with no pebbles or specks. Paint the canvas as smooth cream with a few broad soft folds, with no stitched seams. Make the wheel rims a slightly muted brick red, shaped by light and shadow rather than dark outlines; keep the green stripes and the tongue.
notes.v1_09: Windmill: Remove the stone base, so the tower legs stand straight on smooth, plain dry ground. Paint the grass as a few soft, broad straw-coloured clumps with no single blades or pebbles. Make the wheel rim a smooth metal ring with no rivets; keep the blades, the red tail vane, the sky and the clouds.
notes.v1_10: Campfire Pot: Remove the cabin, the moon and the stars, leaving a soft, dark blue forest behind. Make the kettle smooth, softly shiny enamel and the stones smooth grey with no speckles. Keep the fire, the logs, the kettle on its rock and the stone ring.

notes.v2_09: Mailbox: Remove the house picture from the door, leaving plain blue paint with one soft broad highlight and no scuffs or rivets. Change the sunset to a pale blue daytime sky, with natural mid-green grass and a muted beige dirt road. Keep the red flag, the knob and the post.
notes.v2_07: Baked Beans: Give the beans a soft satin sheen with fewer tiny highlights. Make the bowl rim a cool silver grey with one broad highlight. Make the soft shadow from the bowl onto the table to the lower right slightly darker. Keep the blue stripe, the spoon and the planks.
notes.v2_10: Covered Wagon: Make the canvas plain smooth cloth with no stitch seams and no brass tacks, and the boards smooth with only faint grain. Remove the pebbles and grass tufts so the dirt road is a smooth gradient. Make the wagon's cast shadow slightly shorter and softer. Keep the red wheels and the sky.
notes.v2_06: Guitar: Make the floor a few wide, smooth boards in a slightly paler, even tone with faint seams and no knots. Light the card evenly with no darkened corners or spotlight. Give the guitar top one broad soft sheen and a soft contact shadow. Keep the red pickguard and the strings.
notes.v2_02: Spurs: Make the metal a satin grey with one soft highlight along each bar, in place of the mirror chrome. Make the straps plain smooth leather in a slightly deeper brown, with no stitching. Keep the rowels, the buckles and the blue rings.
notes.v2_05: Cowboy Boots: Remove the spurs. Paint the flame pattern as smooth red shapes with no dotted stitching. Make the right side of each boot clearly darker and add soft contact shadows under the soles. Keep the pull tabs, the floor and the striped wall.
notes.v2_04: Cactus Pot: Add soft, tone-on-tone purple rings behind the pot, evenly bright out to the corners. Keep the cactus, the flower, the pot and the shadow.
notes.v2_03: Harmonica: Make the cover a satin grey metal with one broad soft highlight along the top and a slightly darker front face, in place of the mirror streaks. Make the red end caps plain, with no rivets. Keep the holes and the cyan wave background.
notes.v2_08: Water Pump: Make the pump smooth green painted metal with one soft highlight down the left side, with no speckle, rust or bolts. Change the sky to pale blue and the ground to a soft beige-green with no scattered tufts or pebbles. Make the stone base a plain smooth grey. Keep the red handle and the spout.

notes.v3_06: Tumbleweed: Make the twigs smooth warm brown with soft matte shading, with no bark streaks, grain lines or split ends. Keep the purple backdrop, the sand and the shadow.
notes.v3_07: Belt: Make the leather smooth soft brown with a gentle satin sheen and no stitch lines along the edges. Make the buckle soft satin grey metal with one broad highlight in place of the bright chrome rim. Keep the house emblem and the wooden planks.
notes.v3_04: Boots: Draw the star and swirl decorations as smooth, broad raised yellow shapes in place of the dashed stitching. Make the red leather smooth with a soft satin sheen and no creases. Keep the spurs and the purple backdrop.
notes.v3_10: Campfire: Remove the log cabin and the kettle on its stone, and let soft pine shapes fill that space. Make the ring stones smooth grey with soft shading, with no speckles and no loose pebbles. Lighten the night sky slightly to a deep dusk blue; keep the fire and the logs.
notes.v3_09: Windmill: Make the tower beams smooth orange-brown with soft shading, with no bolt heads or wood-grain streaks. Make the fan blades plain smooth grey with no rivets on the rim. Replace the stone plinth and dirt patch with golden grass running up to the tower feet; keep the sky and clouds.
notes.v3_05: Saddle: Make the leather smooth brown with a soft satin sheen and simple raised edges in place of the stitch dashes. Make the stirrup plates soft grey metal with one broad highlight. Keep the wooden rail and the blue stripes.
notes.v3_02: Lantern: Paint the iron frame a slightly lighter gunmetal grey with soft broad highlights in place of the black with white edges. Let the flame cast warm orange light on the inner cage bars and the top of the base. Keep the glass globe and the cyan rays.
notes.v3_03: Wagon wheel: Make the spokes and rim smooth orange wood with soft shading and no grain lines. Keep only four or five rivets on the rim. Keep the iron tyre and the blue diamond backdrop.
